reason: E1 reports that laser cladding of TiAl/TiC composite coating on TC4 significantly improves performance, and a related TiAlCu/NbC coating increased hardness from 642.3 to 1048.8 HV0.2, but it does not provide specific hardness increase percentages or wear volume reduction for the exact TiAl/TiC system, nor does it confirm the 30–40% hardness and 40% wear reduction claims.
premises: Laser cladding with TiAl/TiC-based powder on Ti-6Al-4V forms a refined, hard intermetallic-rich layer
The cladded layer exhibits 30–40% higher hardness than untreated Ti-6Al-4V
The cladded layer reduces wear volume by at least 40% under room-temperature sliding wear
The improvement is due to grain refinement, hard intermetallics, and compressive residual stresses
